coverage.qualification: The exact marketplace offerings F1607197917 and FR2314156865 are Rev5 Agency Class C Moderate since 2019-10-11 and Class D High since 2024-09-13, respectively, each currently FedRAMP Certified. Both embedded public package records currently have an empty certified_services list. Those values neither revoke certification nor establish product exclusion. The February 2026 Splunk matrix separates Moderate from High: the Platform, ES Essentials and base ITSI rows have checks in both columns; SOAR Cloud, ACS, Federated Search S3, Edge and Ingest Processor and AI Assistant have Moderate checks and High blanks in that dated matrix. The matrix legend separates itemized audit scope and assessment-cycle timing from product availability. The October 19 scoped announcement covers Edge Processor, Essentials-tier Ingest Processor and SPL authoring/explanation in AWS GovCloud (US), with automatic onboarding limited to eligible stacks. It does not certify each tenant, feature or historical release. Current source and canonical qualifications agree.
